mechanism_narrative: Parks mobility has risen sharply from 5.9% to 20.7% over four weeks, indicating outdoor recreation substitution for indoor retail. This sustained outdoor preference will suppress RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks as consumers remain diverted to parks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS increased 14.8 percentage points from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds the mean of the last 28 days, or PARKS mobility declines below 15% in any of the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT station mobility has remained severely depressed (range -25.0 to -32.6%), indicating persistent avoidance of public transport. This sustained transit suppression will constrain RETAIL_REC recovery because transit-dependent populations cannot access retail destinations, keeping RETAIL_REC below baseline.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below -20% for all four weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT has not exceeded -25.0% in any week
failure_condition: TRANSIT mobility rises above -15% in any week, or RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has collapsed from -24.9% to -39.9% (t-1w) then recovered to -25.0%, signaling volatile employment patterns. When WORKPLACES falls sharply, commuting-linked retail visits decline; recovery in WORKPLACES over the next two weeks will trigger retail footfall recovery.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises by more than 5 percentage points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES recovered 14.9 points from t-1w to t-0w
failure_condition: WORKPLACES does not rise by more than 5 points in the first two weeks, or RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM mobility has declined from -4.9% to -8.4% (t-1w) then recovered to -2.3%, indicating tightening then easing of essential-goods restrictions. When GROCERY_PHARM recovers above -2%, it signals policy relaxation that simultaneously permits RETAIL_REC expansion, driving retail mobility higher over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises above -2% and remains there for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved 6.1 points from t-1w to t-0w
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM falls below -3% in any of the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility has remained elevated (3.9-6.4%), indicating persistent home-based behavior. When both RESIDENTIAL stays above 3% AND TRANSIT remains below -25%, consumers lack both motivation and means to visit retail, suppressing RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL elevated in all four weeks
fact:TRANSIT below -25% in three of four weeks
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL falls below 2% or TRANSIT rises above -20%, or RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds the last 28 days.

This synchronized recovery in commuting infrastructure and workplace attendance will drive retail footfall higher over the next two weeks as commuting routines re-establish.

fact:TRANSIT recovered 7.6 points t-1w to t-0w
